current_findings.title: 录制与观察对同一默认按钮的type定义不同，完整回放拒绝正常Save按钮
current_findings.evidence: real_loopback_chrome regression x2, followed by exact source mismatch
current_findings.trigger: <button id=save>Save</button> without an explicit type attribute. Recorder stores DOM property type=submit; observation omits type; strict target metadata equality rejects step 5 even though name/tag/shadow scope match.
current_findings.impact: Fail-closed rather than wrong-element dispatch, but common normal workflows cannot complete. This is a cross-phase descriptor mismatch, not a need to replace the backend.
current_findings.recommended_change: Define one small canonical target descriptor for capture/observe/replay: canonical role, control type and scoped tree identity. Reuse the same semantic functions or generated JS helpers. For button either normalize DOM property consistently or classify type only for relevant controls; preserve strict semantic and unique target guards.
acceptance: record actual parent and existing/dynamic shadow buttons without type, then replay complete Save and assert business value
explicit button type=button and submit remain distinguishable according to the declared schema
same-id/name parent vs shadow targets cannot be substituted

current_findings.title: 回放仅预检参数是否存在，替换后完整动作的长度校验可在先前写操作后才失败
current_findings.trigger: step1 click Save, step2 fill={{name}} with 9000 characters. Preflight accepts and starts; Save fires once; step2 BrowserAction rejects >8000 chars.
current_findings.impact: Deterministic validation errors produce avoidable partial business side effects. This is narrower than promising rollback of browser mutations.
current_findings.recommended_change: Before ownership transfer, substitute parameters in memory for every step and compile each static BrowserAction/verification rule against the existing validation schema; validate keys, URLs, selector/path bounds, text size and supported checks. Do not persist compiled secret values. Still resolve actual target evidence immediately before each action.
acceptance: oversized later text rejected before run.owner/generation change and before any save click
invalid late selector/path/key/verification rejected before earlier writes
valid max-length and Unicode input completes
runtime unknown mutation still remains unknown and is not automatically replayed

current_findings.title: 回放断言的等待语义不一致，title/input_value分支只读取一次
current_findings.evidence: real_loopback_chrome probe; input equals expected after 350ms, initially failed at 0ms then passes after condition reached
current_findings.trigger: Delayed controlled field update or client-side rollback/normalization; input_value_equals/title_contains branch bypasses timeout_ms=10000.
current_findings.recommended_change: Use a shared typed bounded predicate evaluator for URL/text/selector/title/value/checked; expose only booleans for private values. Bind each predicate to current tab/frame/shadow scope and control generation. Failure/timeout is separate from dispatch execution.
acceptance: delayed field/title reaches expected condition within budget -> success
user takeover/session change while waiting -> stop without subsequent mutation
stale success text cannot satisfy a new operation-specific assertion

capability_boundaries.description: Direct-child cross-origin/OOPIF scoped observation/action works; arbitrary nested cross-origin frame paths and transformed frame coordinates do not generalize automatically. Reject unsupported before acting, advertise capabilities, extend only against a real fixture corpus.

capability_boundaries.status: design limitation, not new failure claim
capability_boundaries.description: Workflow replay supports selected single-page kinds and rejects framePath; Skill preview supports the same kinds but does not gate scoped metadata equally. Share a supported workflow plan validator and descriptor schema; parameterize business entities/intent, account/workspace preconditions and result contracts instead of memorizing selectors or adding site-specific branches.

Service already centralizes model/UI/replay guarded action semantics. Deepen that gateway around target resolution, native dispatch and predicate verification, keeping one Octop/CDP adapter. Introduce a second adapter only when a concrete backend is required; swapping Playwright alone does not create generalization.
